problem: Current WP507 CellUptakeReceipt canonical identity does not bind the measurement producer/observer method. Distinct observer implementations/configurations can therefore be invisible to the receipt digest and all downstream summary/result digests when observation payloads are otherwise identical.

proposed_delta.pattern: typed immutable ObserverBinding + canonical digest at measurement-leaf scope
proposed_delta.receipt_rule: CellUptakeReceipt.observe consumes a concrete validated ObserverBinding and serializes observer_binding_sha256 in the canonical receipt payload.
proposed_delta.validation_rule: Before summary admission, recompute/revalidate the exact source binding; reject absent, malformed, stale-generation or digest-mismatched observer bindings.
proposed_delta.propagation_rule: Reuse existing source_receipt_sha256s -> uptake_summary_sha256 lineage; do not duplicate the full observer object at summary/result layers.
proposed_delta.authority_rule: ObserverBinding is evidence metadata only and cannot mint truth, causal promotion, runtime credit, completion or effects.

acceptance_tests: Preregister/reproduce the existing observer-method collision against exact pre-change WP507.
After implementation, identical observation payloads with different valid ObserverBinding digests must produce different CellUptakeReceipt digests.
Swapping two observer bindings across two cell receipts must alter the resulting UptakeSummary digest.
Direct receipt construction or forged observer_binding_sha256 without a valid source binding must fail closed.
Artifact/config/generation mutation after receipt construction must fail binding revalidation.
Opaque provenance_refs containing observer-like strings must not substitute for the typed binding.
Existing receipt->summary->result lineage and all current WP507/WP510 tests must remain deterministic and green at successor scope.
Evidence class must not change runtime/truth/causal/effect/completion credit by itself.
Measure exact successor serialization bytes plus hash/validation p50/p95/p99 and CPU/RSS/I/O where meaningful on the admitted Trigger4 execution surface.

probe_arm_followup.finding: CausalProbeArm downstream_output_sha256 is also caller-supplied measurement evidence and currently lacks typed producer identity.
probe_arm_followup.instruction: Do not claim full WP507 measurement-producer closure from receipt repair alone. Either reuse ObserverBinding for arm output evidence after an exact-source falsifier or record a bounded no-change reason.
probe_arm_followup.orthogonal_witness: R6-SEED-012 ProbeExecutionContext matches non-intervention execution conditions; it is not a substitute for measurement-producer identity.

falsifiers: A newer exact current WP507 successor already contains a mandatory typed observer/evidence-producer binding and validates it before summary admission; if found, reject duplicate implementation and revalidate the existing path.
The E3 collision does not reproduce against the exact predecessor selected for mutation; if so, stop and reconcile before implementation.

A stronger shared F2 evidence-binding primitive already provides exact observer artifact/config/method identity and can be consumed without new authority; if so, reuse it rather than adding a local duplicate.
risks: Binding too late loses per-receipt observer assignment.
Embedding the full observer object in every receipt increases footprint and duplicates metadata unnecessarily.
Treating evidence_class as a quality score could silently mint causal/truth credit.
Duplicating observer schemas across WP507/WP510 would create provenance drift.
A digest proves declared binding identity, not that a real observer executed correctly.
